profile.visual_desc: Tall figure in ornate red and yellow robes with voluminous sleeves. Features a spiked golden sun-halo behind a red-hooded head and a single silver spaulder.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stern expression with dark facial markings around glowing eyes. Red hair is bound by a gold headband beneath a deep red hood.
profile.weapon_desc: Manifested solar energy channeled through both open palms.
profile.step1_ready: Standing tall in a three-quarter ↘ view. Hands are positioned at the sides with the golden halo centered behind the head.
profile.step2_windup: Arms spread wide to the sides. Bright orange flames ignite and build along the length of the forearms.
profile.step3_impact: Both hands thrust forward simultaneously. Releases twin crescent-shaped golden fire arcs that curve toward the bottom-right target.
profile.step4_finish: Arms stay extended as the thermal trails fade. The figure then lowers its arms to return to a neutral standing state.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy arcs in Frame 4 must appear as symmetrical golden crescents projecting forward from the palms.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence maintains correct perspective and follows the reference windup. VFX alignment and timing are consistent with the source material.
